title: The documents page and the consignment addresses hub end with a button reading "Continue"; Design release 1 reads "Save and continue" on both, and reads "Continue" only on check your answers and the declaration

finding.frontend: Almost every journey page ends with a primary button reading "Save and continue", which is what the shared button macro renders when a page passes no primary of its own (src/server/app/shared/save-actions.njk:5, reading src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js:43). Four pages pass their own primary and label it just "Continue", and between them they account for twelve of the sixty-seven captured frontend screens: the accompanying-documents page in all four of its captured states (fe-documents, fe-documents-populated, fe-documents-scanning, fe-documents-error), the consignment addresses hub in all three (fe-addresses-hub, fe-addresses-hub-empty, fe-addresses-hub-complete), check your answers in all three (fe-check-answers, fe-check-answers-incomplete, fe-check-answers-submitted) and the declaration in both (fe-declaration, fe-declaration-error). The two overrides that matter are src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/template.njk:92 and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/template.njk:16, each reading a per-feature copy key set to the string "Continue" at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/copy/copy.en.js:51 and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:8. On both of those pages the "Continue" button sits immediately to the left of a secondary button reading "Save and return to hub", so the page offers the user a choice between a button that says it saves and a button that does not.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 ends the same two pages with "Save and continue". Upload documents states it at app/views/upload-documents.html:245 and the consignment addresses hub at app/views/roles-and-addresses.html:114, and both render it beside a secondary "Save and return to overview". Design release 1 does use a bare "Continue" — but only on two pages, and they are the two at the end of the journey where there is nothing left to save: review your notification (app/views/review-notification.html:184) and the declaration (app/views/declaration.html:91), each of which ends with that single button and no secondary. Across the sixty captured Design release 1 screens the primary reads "Save and continue" on forty-five and "Continue" on seven, and those seven are review notification and its incomplete state, the declaration and its error state, add a transporter, the contact address for the consignment, and add an address to the address book.
finding.difference: Change the two per-feature copy keys from "Continue" to "Save and continue": src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/copy/copy.en.js:51 and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:8. The documents override must stay in place because it also carries name="action" and value="continue", which the post dispatcher branches on; only its text changes. The addresses override carries nothing else, so that page can drop its primary argument at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/template.njk:16 and fall through to the macro's default instead. Seven captured screens change: the four documents states and the three addresses hub states. FIVE MUST NOT CHANGE. Check your answers and the declaration already read "Continue" on both sides, because Design release 1 reads "Continue" there too — so fe-check-answers, fe-check-answers-incomplete, fe-check-answers-submitted, fe-declaration and fe-declaration-error are already right and renaming them would introduce a difference that does not exist today. This is not a service-wide rename; it is two copy keys. Two boundaries with neighbouring findings, because a corpus-wide duplicate sweep has already run and this is a new near-neighbour. First: service-wide--save-and-cancel-buttons-name-the-hub renames the two controls to the RIGHT of this button — "Save and return to hub" and "Cancel and return to hub" — which come from the shared keys at src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js:42-45 and change on every page at once. This finding is the button to their left, which comes from each page's own copy and changes on two pages. Different strings, different files, different blast radius. Second: documents--continue-discards-a-filled-in-document says that pressing this button on the documents page throws away a document the trader has filled in but not added. These two must land together or the copy one must land second, because renaming the button to "Save and continue" while it still discards makes the label state something untrue. One further difference runs the other way and is already recorded elsewhere: on two pages Design release 1 reads "Continue" where the frontend reads "Save and continue" — the contact address page and the transporter-type page — and that is inside service-wide--save-and-cancel-shown-where-the-design-shows-one-button, whose own screens are those pages and whose change removes the surrounding controls at the same time. It is deliberately not folded in here.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a primary submit button whose text is exactly "Save and continue" in the captured DOM of dr1-upload-documents or dr1-roles-and-addresses, or one whose text is exactly "Continue" in the captured DOM of fe-documents or fe-addresses-hub — either would mean the two sides agree on the pages this finding says they disagree on.
finding.verification: Author and verifier are the same agent on this one, and it had no independent verifier — say so when reading it. It was raised after a pre-ingest editor met the difference while correcting a false sentence inside service-wide--save-and-cancel-buttons-name-the-hub, judged it out of that finding's scope, and asked for it to be written up on its own. Every count below was re-derived here from the captured DOM rather than taken from the editor, and they agree. Extracted the text of every submit button in all sixty-seven captured frontend files and all sixty captured Design release 1 files, then tallied the labels: the frontend renders "Save and continue" thirty-nine times, "Save and return to hub" forty-one times and "Continue" twelve times; Design release 1 renders "Save and continue" forty-five times, "Save and return to overview" twenty-nine times and "Continue" seven times. Listed the twelve frontend files holding a bare "Continue" and they are the four documents states, the three addresses hub states, the three check-answers states and the two declaration states — four pages, not twelve. Listed the seven Design release 1 files holding a bare "Continue" and they are review notification and its incomplete state, the declaration and its error state, dr1-transporter-add, dr1-contact-address-for-consignment and dr1-address-book-add. Took the pairings from pairs.cjs rather than from the file names, and read the paired button out of each Design release 1 capture: capture/html/prototype/dr1-upload-documents.html:541, its populated, scanning, empty and errors states, capture/html/prototype/dr1-roles-and-addresses.html:347 and dr1-roles-and-addresses-answered all read "Save and continue", while dr1-review-notification.html:1142, dr1-review-notification-incomplete.html:1074, dr1-declaration.html:320 and dr1-declaration-error.html:349 all read "Continue". So seven differ and five agree. Also checked that neither side styles a link as a button carrying either label: extracting every govuk-button anchor across both corpora returns twenty-one links and none of them says "Continue". Traced the frontend labels to source — src/server/app/shared/save-actions.njk:5 renders the macro's default only when a page passes no primary, and the two pages that pass one read src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/documents/copy/copy.en.js:51 and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:8 — and the Design release 1 labels to their root views, which are app/views/upload-documents.html:245, app/views/roles-and-addresses.html:114, app/views/review-notification.html:184 and app/views/declaration.html:91, none of them under a release subfolder. Opened evidence/frontend@76a864ba/page/fe-addresses-hub.png, which shows the three controls in order: a green "Continue", a grey "Save and return to hub" and a "Cancel and return to hub" link. Nothing here is a volatile value; both labels are literals in source on both sides.

relatedTo.why: That finding renames the two controls to the right of this button, which come from the shared save-actions keys and change on every page at once; this one is the primary to their left, which comes from each page's own copy and changes on two pages. The difference was first written down as prose inside that finding, which explicitly disclaimed it as out of its own scope.

On the documents page this button today discards a document the trader has filled in but not added, so relabelling it "Save and continue" before that behaviour changes would make the label state something untrue.
